units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 34:12">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXIV, 12</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M03082"><he>מַתָּן</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:7">Keth. IV, 7</cite> (in a Chald. formula of the marriage contract) <he>אחראין לכְתוּבְתִּיךְ</he> security for thy widowhood.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>אינון ירתון כסף כתובתיך</he> they shall inherit the amount of widowhood stated in thy K’thubah.
<cite ref="Ketubot 87a:2">Ib. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>ושקילנא מכְּתוּבְתָּאִי</he> and I may take it in advance as partial payment of my widowhood; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="K01352"><he>כְּתוּבָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 31:15">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXXI, 15</cite> <he>לחוד כְּתוּבָתָן</he> except our settlements (deposited with our father).—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:9">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>אקרען כמה כ׳ וכ׳</he> many marriage contracts were torn (marriages cancelled) in Nehardea.
